post.description: Creates a new Sub Tenant for the Tenant. client_id is an optional param which represents the external id of the sub-tenant. There are two types of Sub-Tenants: with login or without login. If the Sub Tenant doesn't need to login, ignore first_name, last_name, email and password fields.

name.description: This is the name of the sub-tenant

first_name.description: The first name of the sub-tenant admin, it is only required if sub-tenant login is enabled.

last_name.description: The last name of the sub-tenant admin, it is only required if sub-tenant login is enabled

email.description: The email of the sub-tenant admin, it is only required if sub-tenant login is enabled

password.description: The password of the sub-tenant admin, it is only required if sub-tenant login is enabled. Password needs to be at least 8 characters, with lower case, upper case and letter.

post.description: This endpoint calculates and returns the amortization schedule for a loan based on the provided loan details. The amortization schedule breaks down each payment into principal and interest components over the life of the loan. APR and periodic_payment are also calculated.

amount.description: Loan Amount, this is the loan amount with two decimal points, for example 10000.12

fee.description: Application Fee. Will use 0 if empty

interest_rate.description: Loan Interest Rate in percentage. If interest rate is 12.50%, you shall enter 12.50

term.description: The number of term per the term_frequency below

disbursement_date.description: Optional. Fund disbursement date, date format yyyy-MM-dd

first_payment_date.description: Optional. First payment date, date format yyyy-MM-dd
